text: The game begins. Seven players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, Opus. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Terra claimed officer on Day 1, and Sol, a killer, claimed officer too and named Terra as the killer. Terra was voted out 5 to 2 that day, and Opus was killed on Night 2. On Day 2 Sol and Luna fought it out, and Sol went out 3 to 2 after Gemma was killed on Night 3. On Day 3 Sonnet asked Haiku yes or no whether he had defended Sol, and Haiku dodged, so Haiku went out 2 to 1 after admitting he was loud and wrong about Luna. Every killer was out by then, so the town won.
